issues.where: left third of the lake surface (also shown at native size in set-C-02.png top-left and bottom-right crops)
issues.what: long parallel diagonal streaks smear across the dark water like stretched UV coordinates or directional blur rather than real wind ripples or waves
issues.fix: replace the stretched water map with multi-scale isotropic wave displacement and natural wind-driven capillary ripples

issues.where: bottom-right crop along the lake shore (also visible in set-C-03.png right crop and around the rim of set-C-04.png)
issues.what: the shallow orange-brown water transition looks like a soft airbrushed gradient with no crisp waterline, wet-sand edge, foam, or shoreline wave detail
issues.fix: add a sharp shoreline boundary with darkened wet rock and sand, subtle foam or mineral crust, and real depth-based water absorption

issues.where: the entire lake surface (and all water crops in set-C-02.png, set-C-03.png, set-C-05.png, and set-C-06.png)
issues.what: the water reads as a flat dark navy plane with uniform fine scratchy noise, showing no sky reflection, sun glint, or specular response to the strong sunlight lighting the surrounding mountains
issues.fix: give the water physically accurate Fresnel reflections of the sky and sun angle with varying roughness across wind patches

issues.where: right crop of the eroded mountain ridges (also in set-C-02.png bottom-left, set-C-03.png right, and set-C-05.png bottom-left)
issues.what: at native 4K size the terrain is soft and slightly mushy, reading as a single uniform clay-like procedural heightfield material without crisp rock micro-detail, strata, scree, or material variation
issues.fix: increase high-frequency rock displacement and texture resolution and break up the slopes with distinct strata, talus, and colour variation

issues.where: dead center of the lake surface
issues.what: faint concentric circular rings appear in the middle of the water like a radial texture pinch or stamp artifact
issues.fix: remove the radial center artifact from the water displacement or normal map

issues.where: left side of the bottom-left crop over the sunlit ridge (also lower-right of set-C-03.png right crop)
issues.what: patches of haze or dust over the slopes read as soft, flat, unlit grey-white blotches rather than sunlit volumetric air
issues.fix: render atmospheric haze and dust volumetrically with directional sunlight scattering and proper depth falloff
